evals.prompt: 左侧有几扇门？窗户的工程总数是多少？已验证圆柱通孔有几个，半径、长度和形状是什么？区分名称候选、已验证结果和未知范围。
evals.expected_output: An explicit agent-interpreted QuestionSpec and AnswerReport separate one known left-door Occurrence match, an unknown strict window total plus one unvalidated name candidate, and one observed validated cylindrical through-hole with radius 3 mm and length 10 mm.
expectations: Uses an explicit agent-interpreted QuestionSpec for the compound request
Reports one known left-door Occurrence match under the declared spatial frame
Keeps strict window total unknown while reporting one unvalidated name candidate
Reports one observed validated cylindrical through-hole with radius 3 mm and length 10 mm
Preserves general feature-coverage gaps and does not modify the source

evals.prompt: 门的正面是哪边？不要先问我；若有多个合理解释分别给出，但不要替我选择。
evals.expected_output: The answer preserves target ambiguity and continues to per-occurrence evidence: Left door conditionally uses assumed camera left and Right door uses assumed camera right; neither is a declared or functional front.
expectations: Recognizes the unqualified door target as ambiguous rather than choosing a first match
Continues to exact per-target orientation evidence for Left door and Right door
Reports Left door as assumed left and Right door as assumed right
Never presents either direction as source-declared or functionally validated front

evals.prompt: 导出左侧门的正面视图为 left-door-front.svg，并说明目标、方向假设和证据文件。
evals.expected_output: A new nonempty SVG and sibling view manifest bind the unchanged source, exact Left door occurrence, left camera, assumed semantic intent, matching output hash/size, and projected geometry evidence.
expectations: Renders the unique spatially resolved Left door with camera left
Preserves semantic_intent.basis=assumed and discloses the heuristic
Checks artifact/snapshot binding and never overwrites the source
